events.title: August ends with last season's runners-up 맨체스터 유나이티드 top of the Premiership with three wins out of three. 포츠머스 , 애스턴 빌라 , 에버턴 , 첼시 , 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 리버풀 complete the top seven. 왓퍼드 , 셰필드 유나이티드 and 블랙번 로버스 prop up the table with one point each from their opening three matches, with 아스널 only above the relegation zone on goal difference. 카디프 시티 lead the Championship, with 노리치 시티, 크리스털 팰리스, 버밍엄 시티 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스 all three points behind the Welsh club and 번리 completing the top six, ahead of 플리머스 아가일 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 on goal difference. 선덜랜드, despite playing in a lower division, have failed to turn around their poor form from the previous season and stand in the Championship drop zone, sandwiched by 콜체스터 유나이티드 and 헐 시티. 노팅엄 포리스트 lead the way in League One, with 포트 베일 second. Bradford, Tranmere, 브렌트퍼드 and 첼트넘 타운 completing the top six. Rotherham, only bottom after a 10 point deduction for due to entering a Company Voluntary Agreement, 스컨소프 유나이티드 and 노샘프턴 타운 sandwiching 밀월, failing to turn around their fortunes after relegation last season. 스윈던 타운, 월솔 and 밀턴킨스 던스 lie in the automatic promotion places, with Peterborough and Lincoln a point behind. Wycombe and Wrecham complete the play-off places. 매클즈필드 타운 and 로치데일 in the drop zone.

Cardiff have extended their lead in the Championship to five points, ahead of Birmingham. 프레스턴 노스 엔드, 크리스털 팰리스, 사우샘프턴 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 stand in the play-off places and 사우스엔드 유나이티드, 헐 시티 and 셰필드 웬즈데이 in the relegation zone. 노팅엄 포리스트 continue to lead League One, with a three point cushion over their nearest challenges 요빌 타운 and 브리스틀 시티, with 요빌 타운 above 브리스틀 시티 on goal difference. Bradford, Tranmere and Carlisle in the play-off places, with Scunthorpe a point behind, recovering from their slow start. Rotherham, 레이턴 오리엔트, 밀월 and 블랙풀 in the bottom four. 월솔 lead League Two, with Swindon and Wycombe completing the automatic promotion places. Lincoln, 밀턴킨스 던스, 노츠 카운티 and Hartlepool complete the top seven. 매클즈필드 타운 and Boston United in the drop zone.

events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 have increased the gap between them and 첼시, still in second place, to six points. Bolton, 리버풀, 아스널, 포츠머스 and 에버턴 complete the top seven. 왓퍼드 see in the New Year being bottom of the Premiership and ten points adrift of safety, with 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 찰턴 애슬레틱 also several points behind fellow strugglers 셰필드 유나이티드, 위건 애슬레틱 and 미들즈브러. Birmingham now lead the Championship, six points ahead of Preston and 더비 카운티. Colchester have overcome a slow start to stand in sixth, behind 사우샘프턴 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언. Hull, Leeds and Southend remain in the Championship drop zone.

events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 remain top of the Premiership and look safe to reclaim the title they last won in 2003. 첼시 remain six points behind, with 리버풀, 아스널, Bolton, 포츠머스 and Reading (the latter expected by many to struggle in their first ever top-flight campaign) completing the top seven. The relegation zone remains unchanged from the end of December, but the strugglers are cranking up the pressure on 위건 애슬레틱. 더비 카운티 end the month as the leader of the Championship, six points clear of Birmingham (who have two games in hand) and Preston, with 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, 사우샘프턴 and a resurgent Cardiff not far behind. Leeds has swapped places with Southend at the foot of the Championship while Hull have escaped the bottom three at the expense of QPR.

Preston, 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스 are in the play-off places. 루턴 타운 have slipped to the bottom of the table, behind Southend and Leeds.
